dynamicTime.title: Dynamic time duration
dynamicTime.description: EL expression returning the time duration (e.g. {#request.headers['X-Latency'][0]}). When set, it overrides 'Time duration'.

banner.title: Warning
banner.text: ⚠️ The latency is evaluated at runtime and no upper bound is enforced. If the value comes from the request (e.g. a header or a query parameter), make sure it is controlled and bounded: an excessive value keeps connections and resources busy and can impact the whole gateway.
